summaryZh: Laboratory of Aging Bilingualism 研究双语者如何控制和切换语言，以及这些过程随衰老和阿尔茨海默病如何改变。团队通过语言任务研究认知机制，并开发多语言命名测验 MINT 及 MINT Sprint 以测量语言熟练度和认知变化。
researchQuestions: 双语者如何控制两种语言，语言切换能力如何随阿尔茨海默病改变？
哪些认知机制解释双语者与单语者的语言表现差异？
methods: 多语言命名测验 MINT 与 MINT Sprint

evidence.quote: The LAB ( L aboratory of A ging B ilingualism)
Department of Psychiatry ; University of California, San Diego
We are st udying how bilinguals control their two languages , and how the ability to switch languages changes with Alzheimer's disease .

When viewed in this way, the goal of our research is to discover all the cognitive mechanisms that produce differences between bilinguals and monolinguals, to determine which mechanism best explains each effect we observe, and to figure out what these effects tell us about the cognitive system and language processing more generally

After observing that bilinguals are not always accurate in rating their own language proficiency, we developed the Multilingual Naming Test (MINT) and a more recent fast administration procedure for the test (the MINT Sprint; Garcia & Gollan, 2021), which provides an objective measure of proficiency and bilingualism in speakers of English, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, Hebrew (or any combination of these languages).
Our naming tests are validated against oral proficiency interviews and are useful for tracking progression of naming impairments in bilinguals and monolinguals with Alzheimer's disease
